mainEntity.name: What types of programs and services does Bellwood Health Services offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bellwood Health Services offers a variety of programs and services, including on-site medical detox, inpatient treatment, intensive outpatient programs, a wellness center, a family program, and 12 months of aftercare services. They address issues such as alcohol and drug addiction, depression and anxiety, PTSD, personal trauma, eating disorders, and behavioral addictions.

mainEntity.name: What is the treatment approach at Bellwood Health Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bellwood utilizes a holistic approach to treatment, focusing on the individual’s unique needs and addressing both addiction and any underlying or associated mental health issues. They combine evidence-based treatment modalities in both group and individual settings.

mainEntity.name: Who is part of the Bellwood Health Services team?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Bellwood team consists of dedicated and highly skilled professionals, including doctors, nurses, social workers, psychotherapists, occupational therapists, and other specialists.

mainEntity.name: What are the accommodations like at Bellwood Health Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bellwood offers comfortable accommodations, an on-site gym, delicious meals prepared by passionate chefs, and ample green space for relaxation. The facility is located within the serene Sunnybrook Park, just minutes from downtown Toronto.

mainEntity.name: Does Bellwood Health Services provide specialized services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Bellwood provides specialized services for healthcare providers, individuals recovering from concussions, and those with eating disorders. They also host the nation’s only inpatient OCD program operated by Sunnybrook Hospital and offer an inpatient Trauma Recovery Program.

mainEntity.name: Whats the cost of treatment at Bellwood Health Services

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of treatment at Bellwood Health Services can vary depending on the specific program, duration, and individual needs of the client. To obtain accurate and up-to-date pricing information, it is best to contact Bellwood Health Services directly. You can reach out to them through their website or by phone to discuss your needs, insurance coverage, and payment options. Keep in mind that some insurance plans may cover a portion of the treatment costs, and financing options might be available as well.

about_blocks.text: Bellwood Health Services, an EHN Canada facility, a comprehensive approach to treating addiction and associated mental health issues is provided. A variety of treatment options are available to cater to each person’s unique needs. Customized programs are developed to ensure the right fit for every client. Recognizing addiction as a complex disease with numerous contributing factors, Bellwood’s staff focuses on addressing not just the addiction, but also any underlying or related mental health issues, such as trauma, that may influence substance use.

Recognizing addiction as a complex disease with numerous contributing factors, Bellwood’s staff focuses on addressing not just the addiction, but also any underlying or related mental health issues, such as trauma, that may influence substance use.

about_blocks.text: A devoted and highly skilled team of doctors, nurses, social workers, psychotherapists, occupational therapists, and other specialists staff Bellwood. Their cutting-edge programs tackle alcohol and drug addiction, depression and anxiety, PTSD, personal trauma, eating disorders, and behavioral addictions like gambling. Services encompass on-site medical detox, inpatient care, a wellness center with optional massage, chiropractic, and acupuncture treatments, intensive outpatient programs (IOP) through EHN Online, a family program for healing loved ones, and 12 months of aftercare services.

Services encompass on-site medical detox, inpatient care, a wellness center with optional massage, chiropractic, and acupuncture treatments, intensive outpatient programs (IOP) through EHN Online, a family program for healing loved ones, and 12 months of aftercare services.

about_blocks.text: Comfortable lodgings, an on-site gym, delicious meals crafted by enthusiastic chefs, and ample green space for relaxation can be found at Bellwood. Nestled within the serene Sunnybrook Park, this green haven is just minutes from downtown Toronto. Bellwood, founded by renowned addiction expert Dr. Gordon Bell, is a fully accredited facility that has been serving the community for over three decades.

about_blocks.text: Specialized services are offered at Bellwood for healthcare providers, individuals recovering from concussions requiring additional support during treatment, and those with eating disorders, supervised by expert psychiatrists and registered dietitians. The facility also houses the nation’s only inpatient OCD program operated by Sunnybrook Hospital. The Trauma Recovery Program is an inpatient initiative designed for individuals who have experienced personal or workplace trauma.

about_blocks.text: All programs employ a holistic treatment strategy, incorporating the most recent evidence-based treatment methods in both group and individual contexts. Treatments can involve individual counseling, motivational interviewing (MI), prolonged exposure therapy (PET), cognitive processing therapy (CPT), virtual reality, and peer support groups like 12-Step meetings and SMART recovery. Program participants have the chance to develop skills in mindfulness, emotion regulation, communication, conflict resolution, and life skills, all crucial for lasting recovery.
